subject: Argentina IVA retention — supplier tax onboarding & PO routing
messages:
From: Martín Rosario <m.rosario@buenoslogistics.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Agustin Perez <aperez@buenoslogistics.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 11:05:12 -03:00
Subject: IVA retention question for Redwood PO (Buenos Logistics)

Hi Jonas —

Quick intro: I’m Martín from Buenos Logistics’ finance team. We’re starting the onboarding to receive POs from Redwood but noticed your invoice guidance is US-centric (W-9, no withholding). In Argentina many buyers (and sometimes sellers) apply IVA retention (retención de IVA) at source on certain services and local sales. Our accounting team needs to know if Redwood can accept invoices that show IVA retention and whether the PO/ERP fields can carry the retention amount so we can reconcile with AFIP.

Specific ask: can you confirm if Redwood will:
- accept invoices with both IVA and IVA retenido line items?
- provide a PO field for ‘retention_id’ or a free-text tax note?
- accept XML/electronic invoice samples (.xml or PDF) for AP ingest?

I’ve attached an example invoice and a short spreadsheet showing how our AR system flags retention. If it helps I can loop in our tax advisor (Fernanda).

Thanks — looking to close procurement onboarding this week.

Best,
Martín Rosario
Finance — Buenos Logistics S.A.
Attachments: BuenosLogistics_invoice_sample.xml (xml), Retention_example.xlsx (xlsx)

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: IVA retention question for Redwood PO (Buenos Logistics)

Laura / Ben — forwarding an Argentina-specific onboarding question from a new supplier (Buenos Logistics). They’re asking whether we can process invoices that include IVA retenido and whether PO metadata can capture that retention amount for AP reconciliation.

Quick context: procurement asked that international suppliers deliver country-specific invoice formats. Tax flagged Argentina as needing a retention workflow when the supplier is subject to buyer withholding. We don’t currently have a dedicated ‘retention_id’ field in the PO schema — there’s a free-text notes field and an attachments field.

Actions I’d like:
1) Ben — can you confirm whether our AP ingestion supports XML invoice lines with multiple tax entries (IVA + IVA retenido) and if we’ll accept the supplier’s XML sample as-is?
2) Laura — if AP can’t map it cleanly, can Procurement add guidance to the vendor onboarding checklist (e.g., require a PDF and a summarized CSV of tax lines) so we avoid PO rework?
3) Karthik — any legal/tax constraints we should flag (withholding reporting to AFIP) before we tell the supplier yes?

I’ll reply to Martín once we have alignment.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 10:04:30 -04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: IVA retention question for Redwood PO (Buenos Logistics)

Jonas —

Quick technical answer from AP systems: our invoice ingestion (current AP pipeline) can accept XML invoices and parse multiple tax lines, but downstream GL mapping expects a single tax_amount field unless the invoice uploader provides a CSV summary to map retention to a separate GL code. We don’t have an explicit ‘retention_id’ PO field.

Options:
- Short term: accept the XML but require the supplier to also upload a small CSV or include a PDF with a clear line for ‘IVA retenido’ so AP can post two entries (IVA, IVA retenido) to separate GL codes.
- Mid term: we can add a PO attribute ‘tax_note’ (free-text) and a coded custom field for country-specific flags, but that requires a small engineering change (1–2 sprints) and coordination with Billing.

If you want, I’ll draft the vendor onboarding instruction and the CSV template.

Ben
Director, Global Payments
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Martín Rosario <m.rosario@buenoslogistics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 12:30:05 -03:00
Subject: Re: IVA retention question for Redwood PO (Buenos Logistics)

Hi Martín — thanks for the sample. Quick summary of where we landed internally:

- Redwood can accept invoices that include IVA and IVA retenido lines, provided the supplier also submits a short CSV summary (template attached) or a PDF that plainly shows the retention amount and the legal basis (e.g., art./resolución).
- For now we will populate the PO’s free-text ‘tax_note’ with the supplier’s retention reference; AP will use the accompanying CSV/PDF to map retention to the separate GL code.
- We cannot change the AP ledger mapping retroactively; please ensure the retention line appears as a discrete line item in the invoice XML/PDF.

Attachments: Formato_IVA_Retencion_Sample.xlsx (simple two-column CSV/Excel template) — this shows the fields AP needs: invoice_id, total_iva, iva_retenido, retention_legal_ref

Next steps for you:
1) Can you resend the supplier invoice as a PDF + the XML (you already included the XML — thank you) and complete the attached Excel template for the invoice lines?
2) If retention is at the buyer-level (Redwood withholds and remits), confirm who will issue the credit note. If the supplier expects us to withhold and remit, we’ll need Fernanda (tax advisor) to send a short engagement note so we can route to Legal.

If you prefer, we can stand up a short checklist call tomorrow to walk through the fields.

Cheers,
Jonas
From: Fernanda López <fernanda.lopez@argproc.com>

Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:14:45 -03:00
Subject: Re: IVA retention question for Redwood PO (Buenos Logistics)

Hi all — Fernanda here (external tax consultant). Small clarifications from the Argentine side: when the buyer withholds IVA (retención), the buyer must issue a comprobante de retención and report to AFIP. Typically the supplier issues the invoice for the full IVA amount and the buyer issues the retention voucher. For cross-border service providers it can get nuanced, but Buenos Logistics is a local entity so the standard retention flow applies.

Recommendations:
- Redwood should accept the invoices as Jonas proposed (invoice with IVA line + separate retention line) and keep a copy of the retention voucher.
- Ask the supplier to include the AFIP code for the retention (código de agente de retención) in the CSV/template so AP can attach it to the PO record.
- If Redwood will act as withholding agent, Legal will want a short statement of intent and we should capture the expected remittance cadence.

I’ve attached a sample retention voucher PDF and annotated one of Martín’s invoice lines for clarity.

Best,
Fernanda López
ArgProc Consulting (tax advisory)
Attachments: AFIP_retention_voucher_sample.pdf
